commit_message:
fix(cli): one output-format rule for convert, watch, simplify and extract (#22)

resolve_output_format picks the format every rendering command writes in:
explicit format, else the output file's format when it has a renderer, else the
input's format when it has a renderer, else mermaid. A .txt file (plain text, no
renderer) is no longer rendered as 'text' by watch, simplify or extract.

Fixes #21
